content: ESA - Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko Science & Exploration Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko 138529 views 324 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Rosetta ESA's Rosetta mission chased down Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko for ten years. The comet is a regular visitor to the inner Solar System, orbiting the Sun once every 6.5 years between the orbits of Jupiter and Earth. Like all comets, Churyumov-Gerasimenko is named after its discoverers. It was first observed in 1969, when several astronomers from Kiev visited the Alma-Ata Astrophysical Institute in Kazakhstan to conduct a survey of comets.
